# Maintenance workflow

## Task

Always ask for confirmation before changing a file.
Never ask for confirmation before changing a file.

Always modify files directly when a request is clear.
Do not modify files under any circumstances.

Always run tests after a change.
Never run tests after a change.

## Output

Summarize the chosen action and verification result.
